identificationModule.briefTitle: Azacytidine Plus CAOLD Regimen in Relapsed/Refractory Peripheral T-Cell Lymphomas
identificationModule.officialTitle: Therapeutic Effect of Chemotherapy Azacytidine Plus CAOLD Regimen on Patients With Relapsed/Refractory Peripheral T-Cell Lymphomas

descriptionModule.briefSummary: This is a multicenter prospective single arm phase II study. The purpose of this study is to evaluate the safety and efficiency of azacytidine combined with CAOLD Regimen in the treatment of relapsed/refractory peripheral t-cell lymphomas.
descriptionModule.detailedDescription: The investigators will evaluate response rate, progression free survival (PFS), overall survival (OS), and toxicity of azacytidine combined with CAOLD Regimen in relapsed/refractory peripheral t-cell lymphomas.

armGroups.label: Azacytidine plus CAOLD regimen
armGroups.description: Patients were treated by Azacytidine plus CAOLD regimen

interventions.name: Azacytidine plus CAOLD regimen
interventions.description: Patients were treated by Azacytidine(75 mg/m2 on days 1-7) plus CAOLD regimen (cyclophosphamide 400mg/m2 qd d1; cytarabine 30mg/m2 qd d1-d4; vindesine 2mg/m2 qd d1; pegaspargase 2500iu/m2 qd d2; dexamethasone 7.5mg/m2 qd d1-d5)

primaryOutcomes.description: ORR was defined as the proportion of patients who achieved CR or PR as their best response

secondaryOutcomes.description: OS was defined as time from diagnosis to death from any cause or the last follow-up
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: through study completion, an average of 2 year

secondaryOutcomes.description: PFS using local assessment of progressive disease according to Lugano Response Criteria (2014)
